faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Common questions
faq.q1: How accurate are the solar forecasts?
faq.a1: Volcast uses a full physical irradiance model combined with weather data from multiple numerical forecast models and your specific system parameters. After calibration with real production data, accuracy typically reaches around 85% on clear and partly cloudy days. Heavy cloud cover is harder to predict for any system, but Volcast still outperforms generic weather apps.
faq.q2: Do I need a smart inverter or specific hardware?
faq.a2: No. Volcast works with any solar installation without connecting to your inverter — you just enter your panel parameters: azimuth, tilt, peak power, and optionally multi-string setup, bifacial factor, and horizon shading profile.
faq.a3: Volcast offers a free tier with 2-day forecasts. Premium unlocks the full 7-day forecast, auto-calibration, REST API for Home Assistant, production history, and more.
faq.a4: Volcast is available on Android (Google Play) and iOS (App Store). Home screen widgets work on both Android (Glance) and iOS (WidgetKit).
faq.a5: You log your actual daily production (just one number). After 5+ data points, the Kalman filter compares your real output against the physical model to fine-tune parameters specific to your installation — accounting for shading, panel degradation, and local factors.
faq.q6: How does the Home Assistant integration work?
faq.a6: Install the official Volcast integration via HACS — it takes 3 clicks. You get Energy Dashboard support, today/tomorrow energy sensors, live power output, and peak production alerts. Just enter your API key (generated in the app, Premium feature) and all sensors appear automatically. A REST API is also available for custom integrations.
